title: Authenticated desktop menu bootstrap

crossYearFixture.description: 메뉴 목록은 JWT userId와 코드의 MENU_ITEMS만 사용한다. OrderYear/OrderWeek를 포함한 ERP 업무키나 MSSQL 테이블을 읽거나 쓰지 않으며 연도가 달라도 원장 부작용이 없다.

dnspyEvidence.source: 데스크톱 메뉴 부트스트랩은 nenova.exe 업무 기능이 아닌 웹 메뉴 조회다. JWT 인증과 MENU_ITEMS 필터만 수행하며 ERP 원장을 조회·수정하지 않는다.
methods: NenovaWeb withAuth JWT userId verification and Layout MENU_ITEMS filtering
tables: UserInfo (login source only; no bootstrap query)

authentication: Existing nenovaToken cookie or Bearer JWT through withAuth; userId comes only from the verified token

response.webVersion: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_VERSION, falling back to the deployed Next BUILD_ID

rules: Preserve MENU_ITEMS group and item order; omit groups with no visible items.
A userIds gate passes only if userIds.includes(verified userId) exactly, including case.
Never expose userIds or other menu metadata in the response.
Return private no-store responses and vary by Cookie and Authorization, including errors.
The route reads no database table and writes no ERP ledger.
